caption: The drawing features a metallic horse attached to a large, decorative wheel. The horse is depicted in mid-stride, facing right, and is rendered in shades of dark gray with some brownish tints, along with a few patches of red, particularly on its upper body. The wheel is circular, also colored in shades of gray, and has an ornate, floral-like pattern with petal-shaped segments radiating from the center. A small section of green is visible between the wheel and the horse, suggesting a harness or connecting element. The entire composition is centered on a light beige background, and there are no other objects or detailed backgrounds present in the drawing. Below the image is a faint handwritten signature.
title: Toy Bell Cart
